title: Resilience takes centre stage at the NAVISP Industry Days
summary: Resilience, maritime and drone applications, and alternative navigation technologies were on the menu of the sixth edition of the European Space Agency's (ESA) NAVISP Industry Days, which brought together over 350 participants in Rome, Italy for two days of discussions, networking and collaboration.

title: MMX Lifts Off on Mission to Explore Moons of Mars
summary: The five-year mission will return samples from Mars’ moon Phobos and answer long-standing questions about the moon’s origin.

title: Help a lost lunar rover find its way in new ESA competition
summary: A small rover is alone on the Moon, with no signal and no idea of its position. All it has is a panoramic camera and an aerial map of the Moon’s surface. The lunar night is fast approaching… can you help the rover find its way before it’s too late?

title: ESA Open Days 2026
summary: ESA Open Days 2026 welcomed over 23 000 visitors across its six establishments, giving the public the opportunity to discover more about Europe’s space activities, meet the people behind the missions and explore how ESA is shaping the future of space.

title: ESA Council approves appointment of two new directors
summary: The European Space Agency Council has approved the appointment of two new directors: Andrzej Banasiak as Director of Commercialisation and Industry Partnership, and Nicolaus Hanowski as Director of Space Operations.

title: Fires Char New Guinea
summary: Emissions on both sides of the island are unusually high as human-set fires spread in a landscape parched by drought.

title: Faster to Science: A Letter to the Science Community
summary: NASA Science wants to deliver science faster, so we’re changing how we compete and select missions. On Monday, October 26, we will host a virtual NASA Science Town Hall.
